function.name: call_mechanic
function.description: Use one game mechanic. name: a mechanic named callable in the latest SYLVIA_GM_CALLABLE_TOOLS record. arguments: an object of the shape its SYLVIA_GM_TOOL_DEFINITIONS entry shows.

function.name: read_tool_arguments
function.description: READ-ONLY: return a game mechanic's arguments. Call it before first using a mechanic that SYLVIA_GM_TOOL_DEFINITIONS marks (read its arguments first).

value.description: The choice it is for (such as the spell), or "".

definitions_preamble: SYLVIA_GM_TOOL_DEFINITIONS (application control, not player speech): game mechanics, each used by calling call_mechanic with its name and an arguments object of the shape shown (? marks an optional field). Before using a mechanic marked (read its arguments first), call read_tool_arguments once with tool set to its name and value set to the choice it is for (such as the spell), or ""; a call before that is refused with its arguments. Each stays defined for the rest of the session; the latest SYLVIA_GM_CALLABLE_TOOLS record says which can be used now.
choices_preamble: Current argument choices (the latest record replaces earlier choices; $ is the argument object and [] means each array item). Each entry limits only the field it names: use its allowed_values or available_fields there. A field not listed is not limited by this record (a target field not listed may name any current creature or object). All other schema and engine checks still apply:
